name: Besties
description: A friendship time capsule — gift box opening, live counter, chapter story, mood-board photos, hidden messages, memory game, and a star-filled finale.

sections.title: Hidden Messages
sections.subtitle: Things you never said out loud

giftNote.label: Gift box note
giftNote.default: A little something I made with my own two hands. Tap to open.

chapters.label: Story chapters
chapters.placeholder:
Chapter 1 — The Beginning | We met in the most random way...
Chapter 2 — The Chaos | Then things got wild...
default: Chapter 1 — The Beginning | We met in the most random way possible. Neither of us knew we were about to meet our person.
Chapter 2 — The Chaos | Then things got loud. And weird. And wonderful. We became a two-person disaster team.
Chapter 3 — The Middle | The 2am calls, the inside jokes, the 'you won't believe what happened' texts. It all became our language.
Chapter 4 — Still Going | Through every season, every version of ourselves, we're still here. And I wouldn't have it any other way.
chapters.help: One chapter per line: Title | Description

photoCaptions.label: Photo captions
default: That one summer
Our first adventure
The rainy-day selfie
That night we got lost
Still going strong
photoCaptions.help: One caption per line. Matches photos in order.

hiddenTitle.label: Hidden messages title
hiddenTitle.default: Things I Never Said Out Loud

hiddenMessages.label: Hidden messages
hiddenMessages.placeholder:
Thank you for showing up when I needed you most.
You make me braver than I would be alone.
…
default: Thank you for showing up when I needed you most — even when I didn't ask.
You make me braver than I would be alone. You probably don't know that.
The way you laugh at your own jokes is my favourite sound in the world.
I don't tell you enough: you're one of the best things that ever happened to me.
If I had to do life all over again, I'd still find you. Every time.
hiddenMessages.help: One message per line. Tap each card to flip and reveal.

gameSubtitle.default: Tap a card to reveal what really happened.

contractIntro.label: Contract intro
contractIntro.placeholder: By continuing to be my best friend...
contractIntro.default: By continuing to be my best friend, you hereby agree to the following non-negotiable terms.

contractClauses.label: Contract clauses
contractClauses.placeholder:
Clause 1: Voice notes must be returned within 24 hours.
Clause 2: …
default: Clause 1 — Every voice note must be replied to within 24 hours.
Clause 2 — No funny story can be told only once. Repeat it forever.
Clause 3 — If I say 'I have news', you must call. No texting.
Clause 4 — You are legally required to laugh at my worst jokes.
Clause 5 — We will always, always choose each other.

finalBody.label: Final message
finalBody.default: Every star in this sky is a memory we've made together. Some bright, some quiet, all ours. Here's to filling the whole sky.
